components.name: Debian base system
components.purpose: Provides the supported host operating system, package manager, and standard recovery environment.
components.installation_source: Debian installer and official Debian repositories
components.recovery_notes: Install a currently supported Debian release, apply security updates, and confirm time, storage, and networking before restoring workloads.

components.name: GNU Bash
components.purpose: Runs the Harbr initialization, validation, inventory, and Docker adapter scripts.
components.configuration_dependency: Executable Harbr shell scripts with Unix line endings
components.recovery_notes: Harbr scripts use strict Bash mode and are not written for a generic POSIX shell.

components.name: Core and filesystem utilities
components.purpose: Provides date, install, sort, stat, move, remove, and other commands used by recovery and API publication.
components.configuration_dependency: Writable Harbr runtime directories owned by the deployment user
components.recovery_notes: The API refresh validates and atomically publishes files with these standard utilities.

components.name: GNU find utilities
components.purpose: Counts local timestamped backup directories and supports targeted recovery file inspection.
components.configuration_dependency: Read and search access to the configured backup root
components.recovery_notes: Harbr does not require recursive read access to archive contents to count recovery points.

components.name: CA certificates
components.purpose: Establishes TLS trust for Debian repositories, Docker packages, Git hosting, and offsite synchronization.
components.recovery_notes: Update the trust store before adding or contacting third-party package repositories.

components.name: curl
components.purpose: Retrieves repository signing material and supports focused HTTP service verification.
components.configuration_dependency: Working DNS, network routing, and CA certificates
components.recovery_notes: Use only documented HTTPS sources and verify repository signing configuration.

components.name: GNU Privacy Guard
components.purpose: Handles signing keys for the documented Docker Engine package repository.
components.recovery_notes: Install Docker repository keys from Docker's current Debian instructions; do not restore obsolete keys blindly.

components.name: Docker Engine
components.purpose: Runs the restored Docker workloads and provides the container runtime required by the backup service.
components.configuration_dependency: docker.service, Docker data root, daemon configuration, and deployment-user permissions
components.recovery_notes: Restore persistent data and host configuration before starting application containers. Pulling images alone does not recreate the host.

components.name: Docker Compose plugin
components.purpose: Applies the repository's Compose definitions to recreate the Harbr-managed application stack.
components.recovery_notes: Use the Compose plugin invoked as docker compose; the repository has no Node or frontend build step.

components.name: Git
components.purpose: Clones, updates, and verifies the Harbr checkout when the repository is not restored from a protected archive.
components.configuration_dependency: Repository access and a clean Harbr source checkout
components.recovery_notes: Git is needed for the documented clone/update path but not when an intact, trusted repository checkout is restored separately.

components.name: GitHub CLI
components.purpose: Supports optional repository and pull-request administration from the host.
components.installation_source: GitHub CLI's documented Debian repository or package
components.configuration_dependency: Separate operator authentication when GitHub administration is required
components.recovery_notes: Harbr restoration and API refresh do not depend on GitHub CLI or its credentials.

components.name: rclone
components.purpose: Lists and synchronizes the dedicated OneDrive recovery tiers used as offsite protection evidence.
components.installation_source: Documented rclone Debian package or official installation method
components.configuration_dependency: /var/lib/harbr/rclone/rclone.conf containing only the required OneDrive remote
components.recovery_notes: Recover OAuth credentials through the separate secure credential procedure; never publish the configuration contents through Harbr.

components.name: jq
components.purpose: Builds, validates, normalizes, and safely merges every generated Harbr JSON document.
components.configuration_dependency: Versioned Harbr source JSON and readable backup metadata
components.recovery_notes: The API refresh stops before publication when generated JSON does not parse.

components.name: GNU sed
components.purpose: Filters rclone directory listings and supports controlled configuration normalization in deployment validation.
components.configuration_dependency: Expected text formats produced by rclone and Harbr deployment fixtures
components.recovery_notes: The Docker adapter uses sed without evaluating configuration content or shell code.

components.name: tar archive tool
components.purpose: Inspects and extracts protected host and Docker recovery archives.
components.configuration_dependency: Readable archive copy, verified checksums, and sufficient recovery storage
components.recovery_notes: Verify checksums before extraction and restore from a copy so the protected source archive remains unchanged.

components.name: gzip archive compression
components.purpose: Decompresses gzip-protected recovery archives and related manifests.
components.configuration_dependency: Readable verified archive and sufficient recovery storage
components.recovery_notes: Inspect the archive format before extraction and retain the protected source copy.

components.name: XZ archive compression
components.purpose: Decompresses xz-protected recovery archives and Debian package metadata when required.
components.configuration_dependency: Readable verified archive and sufficient recovery storage
components.recovery_notes: Use only the decompressor matching the verified archive format.

components.name: POSIX ACL tools
components.purpose: Provides setfacl so the harbr-api group can read backup status and history without receiving broader root access.
components.configuration_dependency: harbr-api group and ACL-capable filesystem containing /var/lib/docker-backup
components.recovery_notes: The host preflight fails clearly when setfacl is unavailable. Reapply documented group ACLs after restoration.

components.name: systemd
components.purpose: Schedules Docker backups and triggers the non-root Harbr API refresh after a successful backup.
components.installation_source: Debian base system and official Debian repositories
components.configuration_dependency: docker-backup.service, docker-backup.timer, harbr-api-refresh.service, and the backup service drop-in
components.recovery_notes: Install unit files from the repository, reload systemd, and validate the timer and success-trigger relationship before relying on automation.
